text:
lina: Started validation thread for NovaEmbed candidate + quant experiments. Baseline float32 recall@10=0.859 on holdout-25k. Quick peek: int8 post-calib 0.847, int6 naive PQ 0.788. Plot upload: https://internal.s3/nova/embed_sweep/3765432100/summary.png :chart_with_upwards_trend:
omar: Nice. Which pooling + normalization? and did you use OPQ or raw PQ?
lina: Pooling: CLS pooling from last layer (cls token). L2-normalize true. Initial runs used raw PQ; then tried OPQ. Eval command below:

```
./evaluate_embeddings \
  --model nova-embed-v1 \
  --pooling cls --normalize true \
  --quant int6 --pq-m 8 --opq 0 \
  --index hnsw --M 64 --ef_construction 150 \
  --holdout holdout-25k.jsonl \
  --metrics recall@1,5,10,median_rank,silhouette
```

lina: After switching to OPQ(32) + PQ(m=8) recall@10 recovered to 0.832 and silhouette improved from 0.28 -> 0.36.
jess: Interesting. Did you also try reducing PQ m but increasing OPQ dim? sometimes fewer PQ subvectors with stronger OPQ helps on short queries.
lina: Yep: m=4 + OPQ(64) gave recall@10 0.839, silhouette 0.39 but index size decreases only marginally due to OPQ rotation matrix overhead.
ryan: How about query length cohorts? short vs long? multilingual?
lina: Short queries (<=6 tokens) have biggest hit: float32 short recall@10 0.81 -> int6+OPQ 0.75. Long queries stable. Multilang (de-de) shows small drop ~0.02. I uploaded cohort CSV: https://internal.s3/nova/embed_sweep/3765432100/cohorts.csv
ej: eval-bot: Automated regression scanner: flagged short_queries delta -0.06 (recall@10) and "faq-anchor" -0.035. Status: needs-triage.
omar: For short queries, try concat-last2 with PCA reduce to 768 then PQ. that often keeps syntactic anchors. Any micro experiments?
lina: Ran tiny ablation: concat-last2 + PCA(768) + OPQ + PQ(m=4) -> recall@10 overall 0.846 and short_queries 0.80. Index size +18%.
jess: That's promising. What's the latency hit with PCA at query time?
lina: PCA projection adds ~0.6ms/query on our benchmark (CPU preproc), acceptable for async endpoints but not for tail SLO-sensitive. We could precompute for stored queries.
omar: Could also look at increasing ef_search to patch recall without index change. What do ef sweeps show?
lina: ef_search: 128->0.789, 256->0.815, 512->0.834 on int6+OPQ+m4. Latency at ef=512 ~2x baseline.
ej: eval-bot: Note: increase in ef_search correlates with QPS drop; adding note to PR checklist.
ryan: Proposed rollout plan: 1) Default onboard: int8 with OPQ for most routes. 2) Experimental route: int6+OPQ+m4 + concat-last2 for higher-value flows. 3) Block int6 on endpoints serving <50ms p95 unless concat or precompute applied. Add silhouette >=0.36 as soft gate.
jess: Also add a targeted retrain of OPQ on a shard enriched for short queries and faq anchors. Might fix codebook bias.
lina: I'll retrain OPQ codebooks focused on short-query shard tonight and queue a fuzz-check of random paraphrases. Will push a small PR with recommended config and cohort CSV in ~45m.
ej: eval-bot: Scheduled job id nb-3765432100-fuzz. ETA 10h.
omar: Great work. If PRs land, I'll prepare canary with 1% traffic to measure live qps/latency and recall via fast-sampled groundtruth.
ryan: :thumbsup: Keep notes in the model-onboard board. Thanks everyone.
